title: Amsterdam
subtitle: Plantage · Autumn rain
author: Fons Heijnsbroek from Amsterdam, Netherlands
description:
Free photo of Amsterdam: picture of buildings at a crossing of Plantage Middenlaan and Roeterstraat ', a picture with light rain in Autumn; it is lunch time. I like very much how the sky and also the trees are reflected in the asphalt pavement. The Plantage district has rich residential houses, mainly built c. 1900. 
In my back is the entrance of Artis Zoo - Monday is not a busy day for the animals and certainly not with this gray and wet weather of November. 

Urban photography of The Netherlands; a geotagged and free download city picture in the public domain / Commons, CCO; Dutch photographer Fons Heijnsbroek, Autumn 2016.
